description: Source code for a GUI component and functions related to time budget analysis in the BORIS behavioral observation software, including a QWidget subclass for displaying and exporting time budget results, and a function for generating time budgets based on observations and behaviors.

classes.name: timeBudgetResults
classes.description: A QWidget subclass for displaying and exporting time budget analysis results, including methods for saving data in various formats and managing GUI layout.

methods.name: close_clicked
methods.description: Saves widget geometry and closes the window.

methods.name: pbSave_clicked
methods.description: Exports the time budget analysis results to a file in formats like TSV, CSV, XLS, ODS, or pandas DataFrame or RDS.
